programme: Generic / Open Elective Courses for Faculty of Humanities and Science & Technology

units.title: Accounting for Bills of Exchange Transactions:
units.topics: Bills of Exchange and Promissory Note: Definition, Features, Parties, Specimen and Distinction. Important Terms: Term of Bill, Concept of Accommodation of Bill, Days of Grace, Date of Maturity, Bill after Date, Negotiation, Endorsement, Discounting of Bill, Dishonour, Noting Charge, Retirement and Renewal of a Bill. Accounting Treatment of Bill Transactions. Problems on Bills of Exchange.

units.title: Depreciation, Provisions and Reserves:
units.topics: Depreciation: Meaning and Need for charging Depreciation, Factors affecting Depreciation. Methods of Depreciation: Straight Line Method, Written Down Value Method (excluding change in method). Method of Recording Depreciation: Charging to Asset Account, Creating provision for Depreciation / Accumulated Depreciation Account; Treatment of disposal of an Asset. Provisions and Reserves: Meaning, Importance, Difference between Provisions and Reserves, Types of Reserves: Revenue Reserve, Capital Reserve, General Reserve, Specific Reserve and Secret Reserve. Problems on Depreciation.

units.title: Income under the Head "Profits and Gains of Business or Profession" and its Computation:
units.topics: Basis of charge and basic principles for arriving at business income. Methods of accounting. Scheme of business deductions / allowances. Specific deductions and disallowances under the Act. Deemed profits and charged to tax. Undisclosed income / investments. Maintenance of accounts, audit of accounts of certain persons, special provisions for computing business income on presumptive basis. Problems on Computation of income from Business and Profession.

units.title: Income under the Head "Capital Gains" and its Computation:
units.topics: Basis of charge, Capital assets, Transfer of a capital asset. Capital gains exempt from tax, Capital gains in special cases. Computation of capital gains, cost of acquisition and improvement. Problems on Computation of Capital Gains.

units.title: Value of Taxable Supply and Reverse Charge Mechanism:
units.topics: Value of Taxable Supply: Methods of calculation of value of taxable supply, Value of supply and transaction value, Determine value of supply where the consideration is not wholly in money, Determine value of supply between distinct persons or related person, Determine value of supply based on cost. Reverse Charge Mechanism: Meaning of Reverse charge mechanism, Key provisions and applicability, Liabilities under Reverse Charge Mechanism, Supplier and Recipient under Reverse Charge Mechanism. Problems on Value of Taxable Supply.

units.title: Composition Scheme:
units.topics: Introduction to Composition Scheme. Eligible person to opt for composition scheme. Composition levy and conditions for applicability of composition scheme. Specified GST rates under composition scheme. Other relevant considerations who have opted composition scheme. Problems on Composition Levy Scheme.

units.title: Labour Cost Control:
units.topics: Introduction of Direct and Indirect Labour Costs and Items of Labour Cost. Personnel Department. Labour Turnover and Measurement of Labour Turnover Methods. Causes of Labour Turnover. Cost of Labour Turnover and Treatment of Costs of Labour Turnover. Time-Keeping Department: Functions, Methods of recording Attendance, Manual, Mechanical and Electronic Methods. Time-Booking: Objectives and Methods of Time-Booking. Idle Time: Causes of Idle Time and Treatment of Idle Time. Overtime: Disadvantages of Overtime and Treatment of Overtime.

units.title: Methods of Wage Payment and Direct Expenses:
units.topics: Time Rate System: Meaning, Merits and Demerits. Piece Rate System: Meaning, Merits and Demerits. Incentive Plans: Halsey Premium Plan, Rowan Premium Plan. Direct Expenses: Meaning, Nature and Collection of Direct Expenses.

units.title: E-Marketing and Green Marketing:
units.topics: E-Marketing: Introduction, Concept, Meaning and Definition of E-Marketing. Online and Offline Marketing, Advantages and Limitations of E-Marketing, Utility of E-Marketing, Challenges before E-marketing, Present status of E-Marketing in India, Scope for E-Marketing in Indian context. Green Marketing: Concept, Meaning and Definition of Green Marketing, Evolution of Green Marketing, Importance of Green Marketing, Green Marketing Mix, Challenges in Green Marketing, Global and Indian scenario.

units.title: Digital Marketing and Social Media Marketing:
units.topics: Digital Marketing: Meaning, Concept and Importance of Digital Marketing, Traditional Marketing vs Digital Marketing, Trends and Challenges in Digital Marketing. Social Media Marketing: Meaning, Definition and Importance of Social Media Marketing, Social Media Marketing Platforms, Strategies for Effective Social Media Marketing, Opportunities and Challenges in Social Media Marketing.

subjects.title: History, Principles and Practices in Co-operation, Paper-III

units.title: Introduction of Co-operation:
units.topics: Meaning and Definition of Co-operation. Objectives of Co-operation. Nature of Co-operation. Scope of Co-operation. Principles of Co-operation. Problems of Co-operative Sector. Challenges of Co-operative Sector. Strength of Co-operative Movement. Weakness of Co-operative Movement.

units.title: History of Co-operation in Abroad:
units.topics: Robert Owen and Co-operative Movement in England. Rochdale Pioneers. Raiffeisen and Schulze-Delitzsch Credit Co-operatives in Germany. Co-operative Movement in Denmark (Dairy Co-operatives). Co-operative Movement in Israel (Kibbutz and Moshav). Consumer Co-operatives in Japan.

units.title: History of Co-operative Movement in India:
units.topics: Pre-Independence Era of Co-operative Movement: Evolution of Co-operative Credit Societies Act 1904, 1912. Post-Independence Era: Five Year Plans and Co-operation. Structure of Co-operative Credit in India: Short-term, Medium-term, Long-term. Multi-State Co-operative Societies Act.

units.title: Introduction to Labour and Employment Law:
units.topics: Concept and evolution of labour law in India. Importance of labour laws in business and employment. Labour laws and the Constitution of India (Articles 14, 19, 21, 23, 24, 39, 41, 42, 43A). Employment contract: nature, terms, and enforceability.

units.title: Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 1946:
units.topics: Scope and applicability of the Act. Concept, nature, and certification of Standing Orders. Modification and temporary application of model standing orders. Misconduct, disciplinary actions, and principles of natural justice.

units.title: Trade Unions Act, 1926:
units.topics: Historical background and objectives of trade unionism. Definition, registration, and recognition of trade unions. Rights, liabilities, immunities, and privileges of registered trade unions. Amalgamation, dissolution, and collective bargaining.

units.title: The Industrial Disputes Act, 1947:
units.topics: Definitions: Industry, Workman, Industrial Dispute. Authorities under the Act for dispute settlement. Procedure and powers of conciliation officers, boards, courts, and tribunals. Strikes and Lock-outs: Legality, illegality, and prohibitions. Lay-off, Retrenchment, Transfer, and Closure.

subjects.title: Personality Development for Business Professionals, Paper-III

units.title: Understanding Self and Professional Persona:
units.topics: Introduction to Self-Development – Meaning, Importance, and Link to Professional Success. Self-Discovery and Self-Assessment – Tools and Techniques (including SWOT, Johari Window, and Personality Inventories). Personal Branding – Concept, Strategies, and Benefits in Professional Context. Professional Appearance and Grooming – Corporate dress codes, personal hygiene, and non-verbal cues. Emotional Intelligence (EQ) – Components, self-regulation, empathy, and its role in modern business leadership.

units.title: Professional Communication and Interpersonal Dynamics:
units.topics: Assertive vs Passive and Aggressive Communication. Active Listening and Feedback Mechanisms. Business Etiquette: Meeting etiquette, dining etiquette, telephone and virtual etiquette. Conflict Management and Negotiation Skills. Cross-Cultural Sensitivity in Global Business Environments.

units.title: Introduction and Role of AI in Business and Corporate World:
units.topics: Introduction to AI in Business: Basics of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP). Role of AI in Business Decision Making. AI-powered Business Automation: Advantages & Challenges. Introduction to AI Ethics and Bias in Business Decision Making. AI Technologies in Corporate Environments.

units.title: Applications of AI in Core Business Functions:
units.topics: AI in Marketing and Sales: Customer segmentation, predictive lead scoring, chatbots. AI in Human Resource Management: Resume screening, talent analytics, employee engagement. AI in Finance and Accounting: Fraud detection, algorithmic trading, automated reporting. AI in Operations and Supply Chain: Predictive maintenance, inventory optimization. Emerging AI tools for corporate productivity.

units.title: Introduction of Retail Banking:
units.topics: Meaning, Features and Significance of Retail Banking. History and Evolution of Retail Banks. Role of Retail Banking within the banking operation. Distinction between Retail and Wholesale Banking System.

units.title: Retail Products:
units.topics: Retail Products Overview - Customer Requirements. Important Retail Asset Products: Home Loans, Auto Loans, Personal Loans, Educational Loans. Retail Liability Products: Savings Accounts, Current Accounts, Term Deposits. Other Products & Services: Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Remittance Services.

units.title: Marketing / Selling of Retail Products:
units.topics: Retail Banking Channels: Branch Banking, ATMs, Internet Banking, Mobile Banking. Direct Selling Agents (DSAs) and Business Correspondents (BCs). Customer Relationship Management (CRM) in Retail Banking. Delivering retail banking products through digital platforms.

units.title: Recent Trends in Retail Banking:
units.topics: Digital Transformation in Retail Banking. UPI and Payment Systems. Cybersecurity in Retail Banking: Phishing, Skimming, Identity Theft and Preventive Measures. Financial Inclusion and Retail Banking.

notes: Syllabus of Generic / Open Elective (GE/OE) Commerce courses for S.Y. B.A. and S.Y. B.Sc. Semester III.
